user.title: CozyLife Local
user.description: Click Submit once to enable local discovery. Newly announced devices appear through Home Assistant's normal discovered-device card, where you choose whether to add them.

confirm_discovery.title: CozyLife device found
confirm_discovery.description: A local CozyLife UDP announcement found **{device}** at **{ip_address}**. Confirm to add it. For a supported sleeping sensor, this uses the identity already captured from its announcement.

abort.already_configured: This CozyLife device is already configured in Home Assistant.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered CozyLife announcement did not contain a valid device identity or IPv4 address.
abort.unsupported_announced_model: The announced device is not an APK-catalogued Wi-Fi product with entities supported by this integration.

init.title: CozyLife Device Options
init.description: Tune local parameters and logging options for this CozyLife device.

data_description.enable_debug: Logs safe protocol summaries and DPID names for diagnosing local transport or entity-mapping problems. It omits local identity and raw state values.
data_description.filter_outliers: Optional four-sample median filter. Rejected samples advance the window so sustained changes are eventually accepted. Duplicate or unidentified reports do not advance it. Disabled passes valid readings, including zero. Enable this option if you experience false-zero readings or other measurement spikes.
data_description.min_kelvin: Adjust the warmest color temperature limit (Kelvin) for this light bulb.
data_description.max_kelvin: Adjust the coolest color temperature limit (Kelvin) for this light bulb.
